Pravin Kadam Certifier & Team Lead — Ahmedabad Office

About

From the spinning floor to the certification desk.

Pravin began his career as a Graduate Engineer Trainee in textile spinning, spent eight years in production and quality at Reliance Industries, and has spent the last five years leading sustainability certification work for Control Union — auditing GOTS, TE and recycled-textile supply chains across India.

His work sits at the intersection of production know-how and compliance discipline: he plans and executes unannounced audits, closes non-conformances, manages certification-body transfer requests, and trains colleagues on policy and procedure. He currently oversees administration of the Ahmedabad branch office and manages a team of auditors across the West and East regions.

He holds Lead Auditor qualifications spanning ISO 14001, ISO 45001, GOTS, TE, GCC, regenagri and BCI, and has completed certification work on high-risk Ginning and Recycling projects.
